directives.treatmentMonitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — cultural participation rate using household cultural survey. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — cultural participation rate measured biannually. Target: 60% population participating. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against EU Eurobarometer culture benchmark. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — cultural participation rate trending toward 70% participation. Escalate if <45% participation floor. A
directives.treatmentEscalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 180 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >30 consecutive days, escalate to a visual arts and gallery management specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 30 days.

directives.treatmentMonitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — artists employment rate using labor force cultural survey. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — artists employment rate measured annually. Target: creative workforce growth 5%. directives.treatmentEscalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 180 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >30 consecutive days, escalate to a literary arts and publishing program director for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. certifiedCortex.notes: Music-domain certification analogue: a culture portal is certified only when artist verification (Spotify for Artists) + rights-holder authority (RIAA/IFPI, ASCAP/BMI) + chart/consumption provenance (Billboard, Luminate/Soundscan) agree. Algorithmic streaming-platform reach (Spotify/YouTube/TikTok) is context-only, never K3 evidence.

portalAccessMap.notes: Structure + reachability only — culture parity with energy-portal-access-map.json, embedded here (single-file constraint) rather than a sibling file, exactly as the infrastructure deep-directives file embeds its portalAccessMap. Culture content only: L1 branches = culture scenes (music/streaming-virality, visual arts, film, literature, theater, fashion, festivals/venues, dance, crafts, architecture, criticism, museums, philosophy, culinary, cultural policy). subtree counts are the branch-size profile; full per-node L3+ portal tree is pending authoring (not yet synced to live or full repo). Certified-cortex authority for music = Spotify-verified-artist + RIAA/IFPI + Billboard + ASCAP/BMI; streaming-platform algorithms (Spotify/YouTube/TikTok reach) are context-only inputs, never evidence. Enables drill-down: civilization.html -> culture -> culture_music -> culture_music_streaming -> [artist/scene-level portal].
